summary: PrfPortfolio is a user control for managing staff expertise, interests, professions, disciplines, sub-disciplines, activities, and associated documents in a web application. It provides interfaces for entering, editing, viewing, and saving structured portfolios of staff skills and activities. The control contains complex workflows for data binding, editing, validation, file upload, and data management, with clear logical separation between skills, interests, and professional activities.
purpose: To allow users (likely staff or administrators) to create, edit, view, and manage detailed staff portfolios, including expertise, interests, professional qualifications, disciplines, sub-disciplines, current employments, activities, and related documents within an organizational web platform.

workflows.name: Edit Staff Portfolio
steps: Bind expertise skills and interests data sources for dropdowns.
Populate dropdown fields with available codes.
Switch to edit mode and show details modal.
User enters/edits skill, interest, profession, discipline, sub-discipline, employment, and comments.
Cache user session and redirect to current page.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Staff Activity
steps: Display add/edit controls for activity if not ReadOnly.
Bind activity keywords data source for dropdowns.
Populate dropdowns for activity role, type, keywords.
Switch to add/edit mode and show details modal.
User enters/edits activity role, type, description, keywords, end date, document upload.
On save, handle file upload, save document, update activity.
Cache user session and redirect to current page.

workflows.name: Handle File Upload
steps: Check if file upload control has file.
Update file URL, path, size, and type.
Delete previous file if any before saving new.

business_rules: Dropdowns for skill, interest, discipline, sub-discipline, activity role/type must be populated from code lists.
If StaffExpertiseEdit fields are empty or string is null, default value is 0.
Screen editability toggles UI visibility and disables/enables fields.
On file upload, previous file is deleted before saving new.
If user session is null, data operations are cancelled.
validations: If dropdown field values are null/empty, default to 0 for disciplines and sub-disciplines.
Page must be valid before executing save command.
File upload only handled if file exists and has content.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable: edit controls visible, else fields disabled.
ReadOnly: disables edit and add buttons.
If dropdown value for discipline/sub-discipline is empty, set to 0.
Activity edit mode is only available if not ReadOnly.
